description:
A simplified touch optimized interface for QGIS in the field.


What's Changed
- Fix loading of content within feature form's tabs when the first trio of tabs are conditionally hidden
- Fix WebDAV download/upload dialog hidden by busy overlay preventing successful action
- Fix NTRIP client compatibility with casters sensitive to HTTP request header elements ordering
- Fix navigation path highlight gone missing
- Derive compressed project zip file name from cloud project name or project file
- Insure that the busy overlay does not cover crucial dialogs
- Mitigate the cost needed when conducting accent-insensitive searches in large value relation lists
🪟 Windows-specific changes
- Fix Store installation / upgrade process
🧩 Plugin framework
- Add object names for most toolbars overlapping the map canvas as well as the trackings (i.e. active track repeater)
Full Changelog: v4.3.2...v4.3.3
